# PS Elite Homestay

> Homestay with budget rooms, AC rooms, 1BHK/2BHK family service apartments and a penthouse terrace suite in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, India. On Air Bypass Road, STV Nagar: 1.5 km from Tirupati railway station, 1.4 km from the APSRTC bus stand and 6 km from the Alipiri footpath to Tirumala. Rated 4.8/5 on Google from 550+ reviews. Bookings by phone or WhatsApp.

Key facts:
- Official name: PS Elite Homestay
- Address: 19-4-9/D/9A, Air Bypass Rd, behind Easy Buy, STV Nagar, Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh 517501, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 93927 39715 (alternate +91 94403 11716)
- Email: pselitehomestays@gmail.com
- Check-in 12:00 PM, check-out 11:00 AM; 24/7 front desk
- Lift to all floors, parking, AC rooms, Wi-Fi
- Google Maps: https://g.page/r/CUrLKvmEc7ihEAE
